verdict.rationale: Stable has a documented public REST API. It uses x-api-key authentication with keys self-managed in the dashboard, and offers reference pages for Locations, onboarding (Form 1583 sessions and signature packets), Companies, webhooks and polling, plus an llms.txt. However, its own docs say the API 'currently' covers only searching and retrieving MailItems and creating and onboarding Locations, so core mailbox actions like scan, forward, deposit and shred cannot be driven programmatically from the evidence shown. Missing for 10: API coverage of mail actions (scan, ship, deposit, shred, tagging and routing), a discoverable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
